user.title: Select your Hue bridge
user.description: Select a loaded official Philips Hue v2 integration. No additional pairing is needed.

abort.no_hue: Configure and load the official Philips Hue v2 integration first.

polling.title: Bridge polling
polling.description: Active mode waits for the first official Hue event. Continuous mode uses bridge traffic while idle. The interval is in seconds.

binding.title: Controller settings
binding.description: Disable its existing dimming automation before enabling control. Sensitivity is brightness percentage points per 15 reported steps; transition is the native light ramp. Buttons activate scenes/scripts or toggle lights on short release.

error.lights_required: Select at least one light before enabling control.

abort.no_controllers: No rotary controllers found. Pair a controller with Hue and reload this integration.
